description: Source code for the Invoice Discounting doctype in ERPNext, including class methods for validation, status management, GL entries, and related utility functions.

classes.name: InvoiceDiscounting
classes.description: Controller class for managing invoice discounting operations, including validation, status updates, GL entries, and related processes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks before saving or submitting the invoice discounting document.

methods.name: set_end_date
methods.description: Calculates and sets the end date of the loan based on start date and period.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures mandatory fields like loan start date and period are provided.

methods.name: validate_invoices
methods.description: Validates that invoices are not already discounted and that outstanding amounts are correct.

methods.name: calculate_total_amount
methods.description: Sums outstanding amounts of invoices to compute total amount.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions upon submission, such as updating sales invoices and creating GL entries.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions upon cancellation, including status update and reversing GL entries.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the invoice discounting document and updates related sales invoices.

methods.name: update_sales_invoice
methods.description: Updates the 'is_discounted' flag on related sales invoices.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for the invoice discounting transaction.

methods.name: create_disbursement_entry
methods.description: Generates a journal entry for disbursing the loan amount.

methods.name: close_loan
methods.description: Creates a journal entry to settle/close the loan.
